name: infoplayerleft
description: Bot de WhatsApp para Steam y Left 4 Dead 2

STEAM_API_KEY.description: Steam Web API key. Required for profile and player lookup commands.

AI_PROVIDER.description: AI provider: local, ollama, llama_cpp, localai, gemini, groq, mistral or openrouter.

AI_MODEL.description: Model name for the selected AI provider.

PAIRING_CODE.description: Set true to link WhatsApp with a phone number instead of QR.

WHATSAPP_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number with country code, digits only, for pairing code.

NSFW_ENABLED.description: Set true only to enable adult-image commands in explicitly allowed groups.

NSFW_ALLOWED_GROUPS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp group JIDs allowed to request adult images.

NSFW_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_URLS.description: Allow image URLs from HTTP/HTTPS hosts outside the API domain.

CONTROL_API_TOKEN.description: Leave empty to disable the local control API on Heroku.

AUTH_DIR.description: Directory for WhatsApp credentials. Heroku storage is ephemeral.
